runs.label: Claude Opus 5.5

calls.say: Rover is at base with all targets sampled; advancing to the end of the episode.

runs.report:
The episode has ended. The rover collected all three targets and was parked about 0.04 m from base when the last telemetry came in. That should give the maximum score of 1.0, but the server computes the score and I didn't see it.

- **Targets:** west (value 1) at tick 6, north (value 2) at tick 16 and east (value 1) at tick 33. That is all 4 of the 4 points on the map.
- **Return:** the rover reached (20.04, 19.99) at tick 41, well within the 0.75 m base radius. Telemetry shows no movement after that.
- **Battery:** the last packet showed 8.71 at tick 77. Waiting drains 0.5 per tick, so it should have been about 7.2 at tick 80, still above zero.

How I handled the unknowns:
- **Bedrock slip:** I measured it at about 3.5% on the first drive and made later drives slightly longer to make up for it.
- **Sand:** only the east target was on sand. Its worst-case slip (45%) could have used up most of the battery margin, so I crossed bedrock to the sand edge at x=23 first. A short test drive there measured sand slip at about 0.24, and I sized the drives to the target and back from that.
- **Hazard:** the route stayed well clear of the hazard north of the north target.
